paragraphs: Huna Mar bar Marimar, [Bava Metzia 81a](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Metzia.81a.5). Yehuda bar Marimar, [Berakhot 45b](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.45b.18-19).[^1]

notes.text: [Heilprin’s entry on Huna](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1009&lang=en) cites the same Bava Metzia occurrence. [His entry on Yehuda](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1710&lang=en) discusses the Berakhot occurrence alongside the Ketubot passages.
